title: REPORT on the European Semester for economic policy coordination: employment and social priorities – annual report 2026
part_text: Calls for an EU directive on a framework for minimum income schemes, with the purpose of safeguarding the right to a decent life and ensuring that every person in need in the EU is covered by a minimum income scheme; recalls that such a directive, in compliance with the principle of subsidiarity, would address gaps in the EU social *acquis* by contributing to the goals of reducing poverty while fostering the active integration of people who are absent from the labour market;
